high_level_description: The image is a promotional piece showcasing an innovative bicycle wheel designed by a student. The text at the top reads, "This Student Creates Bike Wheel With Pollution Filters That Purify The Air While You Cycle," highlighting the unique feature of the wheel. The left side of the image shows a person riding a bicycle equipped with the new wheel. The individual appears to be smiling and enjoying the ride, suggesting a positive and innovative approach to cycling. The person is dressed casually, wearing a jacket and pants, and has a bag attached to the front of the bike.
